basic_info.description: Across from Lafayette Park, this elegant 1-bedroom condo is set in a 1920s elevator building in Pac Heights. Admired for its iconic facade & grand lobby adorned w/ mosaic tiles, marble floors & coffered ceilings, the building is a paragon of iconic SF architecture. Enter into a gracious living & dining room, where soaring ceilings, tall windows & mirrored wall accents create a luminous sense of scale. Custom window treatments, built-ins & wide-plank hardwood floors, and arched pass-throughs offer architectural charm. From this vantage, enjoy outlooks of the Bay, Salesforce Tower & the city skyline. The adjacent kitchen has butcher block counters, SS appliances & glass-front cabinetry.  Bay windows frame the grand bedroom w/ tranquil views over Lafayette Park & beyond. Storage is exceptional, with 4 closets throughout the home, each outfitted with custom built-ins. The bathroom is conveniently located off the main living area. One deeded ind. garage parking space, storage & convenient laundry facility. Positioned in Pacific Heights, 1950 Gough places you moments from Fillmore, Union & Polk St shopping and dining with Lafayette Park as your front yard. Whole Foods & tech shuttle stop are 2 blocks away.
